_meta.purpose: Canonical CONFIRMATION dialog (R = md reference), delivered via the runtime OVERLAY MODE: a screen-sized frame (1440×1024) with a Backdrop (Beta) filling it and a Card (elevation 1) centered on top (cardWidth 520). The Card holds a header (h2 title + one-line description), a body (a leading Notification tinted Critical WITHOUT a close X + a short question), and a right-aligned action row (ghost 'Abbrechen' + Brand 'Endgültig löschen'). DENSITY/STYLE REFERENCE ONLY — do not copy as a skeleton.
_meta.designNotes: A modal is a backdrop overlay, NOT a page: no Header, no zebra, no bento. The Backdrop provides separation, so the dialog Card is elevation 1 (NOT 3 — Level 3 only piles on shadow). All primary copy — title, description AND body message — is color.text.strong (emphasis-100), NOT muted: in a dialog the text IS the primary content. ≤1 Brand action; no danger button variant exists, so a destructive confirm is Brand + severe wording ('Endgültig löschen') with a leading Notification (semantic Critical, closeable:false — no X inside the dialog). The action row is RIGHT-ALIGNED (align 'right'), secondary (ghost) first → primary (Brand) rightmost, as is conventional for dialogs. The runtime overlay mode adds the Backdrop and centers the Card; the plan `layout` is just the Card.
_meta.spacingModel: A modal inherits R from its product (content/website → lg, application/dashboard → md, dense data app → sm) and skews compact. This example is at the R = md REFERENCE, and (per layout-guidelines.md) the Card inner padding and the regions-to-each-other use the SAME step R: Card padding = md (16) AND the three regions (header/body/footer) to each other = md (16) — they match, so nothing is spaced further from itself than from the card edge. Grouped bits (title↔description, footer button pair) = sm (R−1, 12); elements within a region (Notification↔question) = md (R). Substitute every gap per modal/blocks.json → _meta.spacingModel when the product differs.
_meta.colorModel: emphasis-100 (color.text.strong) for ALL primary copy — the dialog title, the description AND the body message/question (the message is primary content, not a muted caption). emphasis-80 (color.text.muted) only for rare secondary helper/meta text. The Notification is tinted via semantic 'Critical' and closeable:false; the Card surface (elevation 1) is NOT recolored; the Backdrop provides the dim.
